`connectFirestoreEmulator` sends this SDK instance to the local emulator address before database operations begin.

blocks.text: After the write lesson, this prints Moon Trip. A missing document prints the fallback.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A document reference is only an address. It does not prove that a document exists at that address.
